notes: Main menu reorganized: worlds are grouped by universe (like Zenless Zone Zero). Open a world to chat with everyone, start a 1-on-1 with any of its characters, see its cast, or pick up your 1-on-1s and timelines there.
Only a character's creator can edit them. Built-in characters can only be edited by the app owner's account. Everyone else can make their own copy to change.
New worlds can be given a universe or series name.
